judge.reason: The replay produced a spec and a TODOS.md plan covering most of the design, but the plan omits the user-requested dataloader double-sharding verification/fix (c7), and the Slurm-side auto-resume design is essentially absent and rests on an incorrect claim that exit code 0 triggers requeue (c3). Cadence and phasing criteria are met only weakly, which lowers confidence.
